```{r}
  mutate(
    clinvar_group = case_when(
      clinvar_clinical_significance %in% c("pathogenic", "likely_pathogenic") ~

      clinvar_clinical_significance %in% c("benign", "likely_benign") ~
        "Benign",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),

  )
```

```{r}
active_positions <- c(24,27,39,41,44,47,61,64,           # RING zinc binding
    3,6,7,8,10,11,14,15,17,18,21,22, 38,  # RING BARD1 interface
    76,77,78,79,81,82,85,88,89,92,93,96,97, # RING BARD1 interface
    1655, 1656, 1657, 1658, 1690, 1691, 1696, # BRCT BACH1 peptide binding sites by chimeraX
    1698,1699,1700,1701,1702,1740,1741,1774,1775,1811,1813,1836,1839)

fil_brca1_df <- brca1_df %>%
  filter(!mutation_position %in% active_positions)

# Fit a loess model using the filtered data
loess_fit <- loess(function_score ~ ddG_pred, data = fil_brca1_df, span = 0.7, family = "symmetric")

# Predict fitted values for ALL data points using the loess model trained on fil_gck_df
brca1_df$fitted <- predict(loess_fit, newdata = brca1_df)

# Calculate residuals for ALL points
brca1_df$residuals <- brca1_df$function_score - brca1_df$fitted

# Generate LOESS fit line from fil_gck_df
loess_fit <- loess(function_score ~ ddG_pred, data = fil_brca1_df, span = 0.7, family = "symmetric")

fit_line_df <- data.frame(
  ddG_pred = seq(-0.6,
                            max(fil_brca1_df$ddG_pred, na.rm = TRUE),
                            length.out = 200)
)

fit_line_df$function_score <- predict(loess_fit, newdata = fit_line_df)

range(brca1_df$residuals)
```

```{r}
brca1_df <- brca1_df %>%
  mutate(mutation_position = as.numeric(str_extract(mutant, "(?<=\\D)(\\d+)(?=\\D)")))

nrow(brca1_df)

median_residuals <- brca1_df %>%
  group_by(mutation_position) %>%
  summarise(median_residuals = median(residuals, na.rm = TRUE))

min(median_residuals$median_residuals) #-3.039259
max(median_residuals$median_residuals) #0.9052505

pdb <- read.pdb("/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1/data/residual_pdb/SGE/BRCA1/AF-P38398-F1-model_v6.pdb")
data <- median_residuals
head(data)

# Create a new B-factor vector initialized with the current B-factors from the PDB
new_b_factors <- pdb$atom$b

# Loop through each position in the correlation data and update the B-factors
for (i in 1:nrow(data)) {
  position <- data$mutation_position[i]
  correlation_value <- data$median_residuals[i]
  
  # Find indices in the PDB that match the current position
  indices <- which(pdb$atom$resno == position)
  
  # Print the indices and current B-factors before updating
  #cat("Updating residue number:", position, "\n")
  #cat("Indices in PDB:", indices, "\n")
  #cat("Current B-factors:", new_b_factors[indices], "\n")
  
  # Update B-factors for all atoms in the current residue
  new_b_factors[indices] <- correlation_value
  
  # Print the new B-factors after updating
  #cat("Updated B-factors:", new_b_factors[indices], "\n")
  #cat("\n")  # Add an extra line for readability
}
# Replace non-matching B-factors with outlier value so we can filter it out in ChimeraX
non_matching_indices <- setdiff(seq_along(new_b_factors), which(pdb$atom$resno %in% data$mutation_position))
new_b_factors[non_matching_indices] <- 999

# Assign the new B-factors back to the pdb structure
# Write the modified PDB structure to a new file
pdb$atom$b <- new_b_factors
write.pdb(pdb, file = "/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1/data/residual_pdb/SGE/BRCA1/AF-P38398-F1-model_v6_median_residual_loess.pdb")
```

```{r}
# 1. Load PDB (Ensure this path is correct)
pdb_path <- "/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1/data/residual_pdb/SGE/BRCA1/1JM7.pdb"
pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_path)

bard1_binding <- c(3,6,7,8,10,11,14,15,17,18,21,22, 38,  # RING BARD1 interface
    76,77,78,79,81,82,85,88,89,92,93,96,97) # RING BARD1 interface)
zinc_site <- c(24,27,39,41,44,47,61,64)           # RING zinc binding

active_positions <- c(bard1_binding , zinc_site)
# 3. Get Active Site Coordinates (Using the CORRECT 'string' argument)
# This was likely the missing piece in your previous environment
site_inds <- atom.select(pdb, resno = active_positions, string = "noh")
site_xyz <- pdb$xyz[site_inds$xyz]

# Check immediately
if (length(site_inds$atom) == 0) {
  stop("STOP: Active site atoms are 0. The Code will not work.")
} else {
  print(paste("Active Site Loaded: Found", length(site_inds$atom), "atoms."))
}

# 4. Redefine the Function (The Robust Version)
calc_min_heavy_dist <- function(res_num, pdb_obj, site_coords) {
  
  # Bio3D is strict: 'resno' must be numeric. 
  # We force it here to fix the error you saw in Test B.
  res_num <- as.numeric(as.character(res_num))
  
  # Use 'string = "noh"' (The fix confirmed by Test A)
  target_inds <- atom.select(pdb_obj, resno = res_num, string = "noh")
  
  # Safety catch for missing residues
  if (length(target_inds$atom) == 0) return(NA)
  
  # Calculate
  target_xyz <- pdb_obj$xyz[target_inds$xyz]
  t_mat <- matrix(target_xyz, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  s_mat <- matrix(site_coords, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  
  return(min(dist.xyz(t_mat, s_mat), na.rm = TRUE))
}

# 5. Run Calculation
unique_positions <- unique(brca1_df$mutation_position)

print("Starting calculation loop...")

dist_vals <- sapply(unique_positions, function(x) {
  calc_min_heavy_dist(x, pdb, site_xyz)
})

# 6. Map Back Safely
# explicitly name the vector to ensure matching works
names(dist_vals) <- as.character(unique_positions) 

# Assign based on character matching
ring_df <- brca1_df %>% filter(mutation_position < 102) %>% filter(mutation_position > 8)
nrow(ring_df)
ring_df$min_dist_to_site <- dist_vals[as.character(ring_df$mutation_position)]

# 7. Final Result
print(paste("Final NAs:", sum(is.na(ring_df$min_dist_to_site))))
head(ring_df$min_dist_to_site)

# If NAs remain, it means those specific residues are missing from the PDB structure 
# (common in loop regions), which is normal.
# Filter out NAs (residues not found in PDB structure)
ring_df <- ring_df %>% filter(!is.na(min_dist_to_site))
```


```{r}
ring_df_neg <- ring_df %>% filter(residuals <= 0)
nrow(ring_df_neg) 

# Fit exponential decay: y = a * exp(-b * x) + c
exp_model <- nls(abs(residuals) ~ a * exp(-b * min_dist_to_site),
                 data = ring_df_neg,
                 start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1))
exp_model
```
```{r}
a <- coef(exp_model)[["a"]]
b <- coef(exp_model)[["b"]]
```

```{r}
# 1. Load PDB (Ensure this path is correct)
pdb_path <- "/Users/xl7/Documents/0.Projects/01.protein-seq-evo-v1/data/residual_pdb/SGE/BRCA1/1T29.pdb"
pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_path)

bach1_pos <- c(1655, 1656, 1657, 1658, 1690, 1691, 1696, # BRCT BACH1 peptide binding sites by chimeraX
    1698,1699,1700,1701,1702,1740,1741,1774,1775,1811,1813,1836,1839)

# 3. Get Active Site Coordinates (Using the CORRECT 'string' argument)
# This was likely the missing piece in your previous environment
site_inds <- atom.select(pdb, resno = bach1_pos, string = "noh")
site_xyz <- pdb$xyz[site_inds$xyz]

# Check immediately
if (length(site_inds$atom) == 0) {
  stop("STOP: Active site atoms are 0. The Code will not work.")
} else {
  print(paste("Active Site Loaded: Found", length(site_inds$atom), "atoms."))
}

# 4. Redefine the Function (The Robust Version)
calc_min_heavy_dist <- function(res_num, pdb_obj, site_coords) {
  
  # Bio3D is strict: 'resno' must be numeric. 
  # We force it here to fix the error you saw in Test B.
  res_num <- as.numeric(as.character(res_num))
  
  # Use 'string = "noh"' (The fix confirmed by Test A)
  target_inds <- atom.select(pdb_obj, resno = res_num, string = "noh")
  
  # Safety catch for missing residues
  if (length(target_inds$atom) == 0) return(NA)
  
  # Calculate
  target_xyz <- pdb_obj$xyz[target_inds$xyz]
  t_mat <- matrix(target_xyz, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  s_mat <- matrix(site_coords, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  
  return(min(dist.xyz(t_mat, s_mat), na.rm = TRUE))
}

# 5. Run Calculation
unique_positions <- unique(brca1_df$mutation_position)

print("Starting calculation loop...")

dist_vals <- sapply(unique_positions, function(x) {
  calc_min_heavy_dist(x, pdb, site_xyz)
})

# 6. Map Back Safely
# explicitly name the vector to ensure matching works
names(dist_vals) <- as.character(unique_positions) 

# Assign based on character matching
brct_df <- brca1_df %>% filter(mutation_position < 1860) %>% filter(mutation_position > 1648)
nrow(brct_df)
brct_df$min_dist_to_site <- dist_vals[as.character(brct_df$mutation_position)]

# 7. Final Result
print(paste("Final NAs:", sum(is.na(brct_df$min_dist_to_site))))
head(brct_df$min_dist_to_site)

# If NAs remain, it means those specific residues are missing from the PDB structure 
# (common in loop regions), which is normal.
# Filter out NAs (residues not found in PDB structure)
brct_df <- brct_df %>% filter(!is.na(min_dist_to_site))
nrow(brct_df) #
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 0) Settings
# ---------------------------
set.seed(11)
n_boot <- 1000
match_window <- 0.5

# ---------------------------
# 1) Define groups for plotting
# ---------------------------
# Keep Benign + Pathogenic as-is
bp_df <- brca1_df %>%
  filter(clinvar_group %in% c("Benign", "Pathogenic")) %>%
  mutate(group = clinvar_group) %>%
  dplyr::select(mutant, ddG_pred, residuals, group)

# Pathogenic set (for abundance matching target)
patho_df <- bp_df %>%
  filter(group == "Pathogenic") %>%
 dplyr::select(mutant, ddG_pred, residuals, group)

n_patho <- nrow(patho_df)

# Pool to sample from: Others (exclude pathogenic variants explicitly by mutant)
# If you don't have mutant IDs, remove the anti_join and just use clinvar_group == "Other"
non_patho_pool <- brca1_df %>%
  filter(clinvar_group == "Other") %>%
  anti_join(patho_df %>% dplyr::select(mutant), by = "mutant") %>%
  dplyr::select(ddG_pred, residuals)

# ---------------------------
# 2) Abundance binning + bootstrap abundance-matched "Others"
# ---------------------------
# dynamic breaks that cover both sets
all_x <- c(patho_df$ddG_pred, non_patho_pool$ddG_pred)

breaks_vec <- seq(min(all_x, na.rm = TRUE),
                  max(all_x, na.rm = TRUE) + match_window,
                  by = match_window)

non_patho_pool <- non_patho_pool %>%
  mutate(bin = cut(ddG_pred, breaks = breaks_vec, include.lowest = TRUE))

patho_df_binned <- patho_df %>%
  mutate(bin = cut(ddG_pred, breaks = breaks_vec, include.lowest = TRUE))

bin_lookup <- split(non_patho_pool$residuals, non_patho_pool$bin)

bootstrap_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_boot, ncol = nrow(patho_df_binned))

for (i in seq_len(n_boot)) {
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(patho_df_binned))) {
    bin_j <- patho_df_binned$bin[j]
    candidates <- bin_lookup[[as.character(bin_j)]]
    if (length(candidates) > 0) {
      bootstrap_matrix[i, j] <- sample(candidates, 1)
    }
  }
}

boot_df <- tibble(
  group = "Abundance-matched null (bootstrapped medians)",
  residuals = apply(bootstrap_matrix, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# ---------------------------
# 3) Combine into one plotting df (3 violins)
# ---------------------------
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  bp_df %>% dplyr::select(group, residuals),
  boot_df
)

desired_order <- c("Benign", "Abundance-matched null (bootstrapped medians)", "Pathogenic")
plot_df$group <- factor(plot_df$group, levels = desired_order)

custom_colors <- c(
  "Benign" = "grey70",
  "Pathogenic" = "firebrick3",
  "Abundance-matched null (bootstrapped medians)" = "grey30"
)

# Labels (n + median)
label_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    median_val = median(residuals, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_label = case_when(
      group == "Abundance-matched null (bootstrapped medians)" ~ paste0("bootstrapped ", n_boot, "×"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("n = ", n)
    )
  )

# ---------------------------
# 4) Plot
# ---------------------------
p_violin3 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = group, y = residuals, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "width", alpha = 0.8, color = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.4, color = "black", fatten = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 2.5,
               fill = "black", color = "black", stroke = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_df,
    aes(x = group, y = 3, label = n_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_df,
    aes(x = group, y = median_val + 0.25, label = sprintf("%.2f", median_val)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "BRCA1",
    x = "",
    y = "SGE-TMPNN ddGf residuals",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(
      c("Benign", "Pathogenic"),
      c("Pathogenic", "Abundance-matched null (bootstrapped medians)")
    ),
    map_signif_level = FALSE,
    test = "wilcox.test",
    step_increase = 0.1,
    textsize = 3,
    tip_length = 0.01
  )

p_violin3
```
